Name: Surprise Pregnancy
Author: miphasgrace2
AuthorLabel: Hangy - Public Source Code  MiphasGrace2 - Rework
Description:
With this mod, the player will never know there is a pregnancy until the birth event happens.

You will NEVER see the dialogue question box from your spouse asking if you should have a baby at any time during gameplay. Instead, the answer will always be registered as Yes behind the scenes when and if the game attempts to ask. 

You will, however, still see any following potential During Pregnancy dialogue which can come from your spouse, as well as any mods which add events or dialogue while the player status is "Pregnant" 


I HIGHLY suggest pairing this mod with: 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3311]

[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6578]﻿Pregnancy and Birth Events


[/url]To really get a more immersive pregnancy experience. ﻿Unless, of course, you truly want to simply give birth just like the barn animals do without warning. Surprise! 


This mod is a reversal of the public source code for "No Kids Ever."
